Chain rule: after a pair (uql, awa), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is awa. Start at uql: the pair (uql, awa) comes first; its second item is awa, so the next pair is the one whose first item is awa: (awa, bzl). Its second item is bzl, but bzl never appears as a first item - so bzl is the dangling end of the chain.
